source.limitations: Transcribed from the Hancock Public Health PDF 2026 REGISTERED SEPTAGE HAULERS, linked as “2026 Licensed Septage Haulers” from the Forms and Permits page (https://www.hancockph.com/forms-and-permits). Printed footer updated: 1/29/2026, page 1. Publisher block on the PDF: 2225 Keith Parkway, Findlay, Ohio 45840, Phone 419-424-7105, Fax 419-424-7872, www.HancockPH.com. The footer wraps the title as “2026 REGISTERED SEPTAGE WAISTE HAULERS” (WAISTE as printed). The roster prints 11 named firms and no TOTAL line; this file has 11 records. Columns are NAME, ADDRESS, CITY, Phone, and Alt Phone. Operator names and local registration numbers are not on this PDF and are omitted. Spellings kept as printed, including STIGER PRECAST INC. with a period after INC., TE PRICE INC and RANDY MASTIN SEPTIC TANK INC with no period after INC, HORSES SANITATION SERVICE without an apostrophe, DISTEL'S SEPTIC SERVICE with the apostrophe, and RELIABLE ONSITE SERVICES as the NAME (not United Rentals). The printed name RANDY MASTIN SEPTIC TANK INC overflows the NAME column; the C of INC crosses the grid line into the ADDRESS cell, which prints 12004 WATERVILLE on the first line and SWANTON RD on the second; those address lines are joined with a space. HOOVER SEPTIC TANK CLEANING and ALLEN HUGHES SEPTIC TANK SERVICE wrap inside the NAME column and are joined with a space. Phones are shown as printed, including Alt Phone 419-409-0344 on TE PRICE INC and the repeated 313-676-1083 Alt Phone on RELIABLE ONSITE SERVICES. ODH statewide bond status is not on this PDF (marked unknown). Designer, installer, inspector, and registration-form PDFs on the Forms and Permits page were not transcribed and were not merged. The ODH statewide septage-hauler bond list was not merged. A septage hauler registration is not a service-provider inspection credential. Appearance is not an endorsement. Verify with Hancock Public Health and ODH before you hire.
